ApplicationPackage.Author: HairuoLiu
ApplicationPackage.Name: Camera Lens and Filter Threads
ApplicationPackage.Description: Adds camera lens and filter thread sizes (24-127 mm, 0.75/1.0 mm pitch) plus the Leica Thread Mount (L39/LTM, 39 mm x 26 TPI = 0.976923 mm, incl. a Whitworth 55 deg family) to Fusion 360's Thread Type dropdown.

ComponentEntry.AppDescription: Installs lens/filter thread definitions into Fusion 360.
